name: Periapt of Wound Closure
description:
While wearing this pendant, you gain the following benefits.
Life Preservation. Whenever you make a Death
Saving Throw, you can change a roll of 9 or lower to a 10, turning a failed save into a successful one.
Natural Healing Boost. Whenever you roll a Hit
Point Die to regain Hit Points, double the number of Hit Points it restores.
